items.stem: Which TWO statements about form validation are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Client-side validation improves UX but is not a security control
options.rationale: Correct: client checks help users but can be bypassed.

options.text: The server must still validate submitted data
options.rationale: Correct: trustworthy validation happens on the server.

options.text: Client-side validation alone is sufficient for security
options.rationale: Clients can be bypassed, so this is unsafe.

options.text: Errors should be hidden from screen readers
options.rationale: Errors must be accessible to assistive technology.

items.explanation: Correct: client checks help users but can be bypassed.
